title: Tabernacle and Bins
description: Two-register installation combining an upper horizontal panel—dense with collaged photographs, red line drawings, and a propeller aircraft silhouette against terracotta grounds—and three freestanding vertical cabinet forms below, each bearing painted motifs: a football outline, a goal post, and circular vinyl record imagery amid washes of blue, ochre, and pink.
composition: two-register sculpture, horizontal cabinet over three vertical boxes
